summary: Iteration 3 both-track testing complete. Backend: 46/46 pytest cases pass (23 legacy + 11 iteration-2 + 12 new iteration-3). Fixed legacy fixtures (backend_test.py and test_iteration2.py) to use /auth/register instead of /auth/login for new user creation since login no longer auto-creates. New test_iteration3.py covers: login 404 for unregistered phone, register 409 on duplicate phone, seller role creates linked seller_id doc, PUT /profile mirrors name/avatar/district/village to seller, /wallet/withdraw rejects on 0 and insufficient balance, admin approve deducts via $inc, approve w/ insufficient marks rejected and returns 400, reject no-deduct, metrics includes pending_withdrawals, YouTube URL auto-sets img.youtube.com poster. Frontend: validated via Playwright - auth-tab-login/register toggle, login 404 auto-switches to Register tab, register 409 auto-switches to Login tab, session persists in localStorage after reload, buyer wallet shows ONLY deposit (no withdraw-section), seller wallet has deposit+withdraw sub-tabs with WithdrawForm (bkash/nagad/rocket), over-balance withdraw shows error toast ('ওয়ালেটে পর্যাপ্ত ব্যালেন্স নেই'), buyer-edit-profile-btn and seller-edit-profile-btn both open edit-profile-modal with name/avatar-url/file/district/village/save fields, YouTube reel upload renders real YouTube iframe (src=youtube.com/embed/.../autoplay=1&mute=1&loop=1) when active in vertical feed with img.youtube.com poster fallback, direct MP4 reels still render <video>, admin /admin-secret-portal (admin/Rumpaontu15@) still works with both Deposits and new Withdrawals tabs; home-admin-btn and admin-dashboard-link both absent on public pages.
critical_code_review_comments: Withdraw approve path uses $inc wallet with -amount but has a TOCTOU race: between find_one check and update_one, another approve for a different withdrawal of the same user could pass the balance check twice. For a single admin workflow this is acceptable; for scale use conditional update with filter {'wallet': {'$gte': amount}}.

AuthInput.name defaults to "" but /auth/register validates `if not data.name`. Model allows passing name="" which triggers 400. Fine, but the Pydantic validation layer could enforce min_length=1 to centralize the rule.

ProfileInput.district/village can be None but code only skips None values. Sending empty string will update to empty string (clearing it). Possibly intentional, but no guard against clearing to empty.

parseVideo in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js: current code works for watch?v= and youtu.be, but iframe uses &playlist=<id>&loop=1 only for loop support; works. No support for Facebook video URL on backend thumbnail (OK, falls back to category image).
server.py `from typing import List` unused (still present) - minor.
Admin APIs still unauthenticated (same as iteration 2 note). MVP ok.
